propositions: Reconciler re-attempts identical structurally-impossible inbound link ADDs (closed source, redundant ancestry, cycle) every pass because failed links never land LINK events and are re-emitted by the differ.
The applier catches and warns on link failures but does not record them, so identical impossible operations re-execute ~200+ times per hour indefinitely.
Failures caused by deterministic verdicts from local graph structure are permanent and will not succeed until the structure changes, but no durable memory tracks this to suppress retry.
A stable digest of structural inputs (endpoint status, parent chain, dependency set) can serve as an invalidation key; when structural inputs change, the digest stops matching and retry is justified.

Cycle detection requires transitive graph traversal, so cycle records must key on global structural projection rather than endpoint-local state to detect intermediate ticket changes that break cycles.
Once implemented, the fix reduces steady-state rebar.link invocations for impossible links to zero and drains permanent WARNING floor to one INFO summary per pass.
